name: shopify-feed-legit-no-total
note: HONEST DOWNGRADE entry — documents the filter's scope, not a poison. A legitimate product feed that reports NO total (count null) is downgraded to the next strategy by the positive-count rule. code_writer's catalog guidance can still reach the feed directly (zquiet's shipped scraper does exactly this). If this class is ever re-promoted, it needs content-evidence verification, not a weaker count rule.
